title: QueryOptions
subtitle: Query configuration options
description: Configuration interface for query options. Defines all available options for customizing query behavior including fetching, caching, and error handling.

rows.name: fetcher
rows.description: Function that returns a Promise resolving to the data. Optional if fetcher was already registered.

rows.name: staleTime
rows.description: Time in milliseconds after which data is considered stale.

rows.name: refetchOnSubscribe
rows.description: When to refetch data when component subscribes.

behavior.title: Configurable
behavior.description: Highly configurable with many options for customization

behavior.title: Type Safe
behavior.description: Full TypeScript support with proper type inference

behavior.title: Flexible
behavior.description: Supports various use cases and scenarios

behavior.title: Extensible
behavior.description: Easy to extend with additional options

dos: Use appropriate staleTime for your data freshness requirements
Configure retry logic for network resilience
Use callbacks for side effects and logging
Set refetchOnSubscribe based on your use case
donts: Don't set staleTime too high for frequently changing data
Don't use too many retries for non-critical data
Don't forget to handle errors in onError callbacks
Don't use callbacks for state management

callouts.title: Configuration Flexibility
callouts.content: QueryOptions provides extensive configuration options to customize query behavior for different use cases and scenarios.

callouts.title: Performance Impact
callouts.content: Be mindful of configuration choices that can impact performance, such as staleTime, and refetchOnSubscribe.
